11bb697ec74ff8bedc5d4284110aef0a6169afd8.summary: The GReAT team reports the EastWind campaign, first detected in late July 2024. Phishing emails with malicious shortcut attachments reached dozens of computers at Russian government organizations and IT companies. The malware used Dropbox for commands and loaded further tools: a GrewApacha RAT that the report links to APT31, an updated CloudSorcerer backdoor, and a new PlugY implant that the report says shares code with DRBControl, which several companies link to APT27.

11fcd89425219e6f04a62fc062c9284bbb39ac82.summary: Huntress analyses a macOS intrusion that began on June 11, 2025 at a cryptocurrency foundation. A fake Zoom meeting with deepfakes led to a malicious Zoom extension download. The report attributes the intrusion with high confidence to North Korea's TA444 (BlueNoroff). Eight malicious binaries were recovered: a Nim persistence implant, a Go backdoor (Root Troy V4), a loader, a keylogger with screen and clipboard capture, a Nim command implant, and a Go cryptocurrency wallet infostealer. Techniques include AppleScript delivery, process injection, shell history removal and sleep-time command…
